card.name: First letter starting a new word
card.fires_on: A single capital or lowercase letter such as D, d, L or the start 'hom' that begins a word right after a heading, list label or punctuation, often in drug labels. The rest of the word follows in the next piece (dapagliflozin, dolutegravir, diltiazem).

modes.label: D starting a drug name
modes.description: The letter D opens a drug name such as dapagliflozin, dolutegravir or diltiazem after a heading or colon.

modes.label: Other word-initial letter
modes.description: A lone letter beginning an ordinary word or a sentence in text.

card.writes: It suppresses sexuality-related words, suggesting it steers the model away from completing a word that way.
card.plain: It fires on a lone first letter, often D of a drug name, before the rest of the word appears.
